query:
SELECT LOWER(language) AS "lang!",
                COUNT(*) AS "sessions!",
                AVG(avg_viewers) AS "avg_v?"
         FROM twitch_stream_sessions
         WHERE started_at >= $1 AND LOWER(streamer_login) = $2 AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
           AND COALESCE(language,'') <> ''
         GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
